answer_1.quote: We propose a new method called CRUSH ... to identify a small, high-recall subset of schema elements for a downstream Text-to-SQL stage.

answer_2.quote: We use the state-of-art RES-DSQL model for generating the SQL using the schema subset selected by various systems. Following standard practice, we use Exact Match (EM) and Execution Match (EX) accuracy to evaluate the quality of the generated SQL.
